verdict.rationale: LlamaParse exposes a REST API, CLI, and SDKs (Python/TS/Go/Java) with a documented async job/parse call and webhook callbacks instead of polling, making it straightforward to run headlessly in CI pipelines; a live OpenAPI spec confirms a working, auth-gated parsing endpoint. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD example (e.g., GitHub Actions) or independent report of running it in an automated pipeline.
